title: Cardamom Rose Pistachio Cupcakes
shortDescription: Spiced cardamom cupcakes with rose frosting and pistachio crunch, ready in 25 minutes prep and 18 minutes bake.
description: These cupcakes came from my love of gulab jamun. The soft milk dumplings soaked in rose syrup that show up at every Persian and South Asian celebration I have been to. I wanted that same warm cardamom and rose combo, but in cupcake form.
ingredients: 1 drop pink gel food coloring, optional
1 tbsp dried rose petals, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 12 cup muffin pan with paper liners.
Whisk flour, baking powder, salt, and cardamom in a bowl. Set aside.
Beat butter and sugar together until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each. Mix in vanilla.
Add flour mix and milk in three alternating additions, starting and ending with flour. Stir in rose water.
Divide batter among liners, filling each two thirds full. Bake 16 to 18 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool cupcakes in the pan 5 minutes, then move to a wire rack to cool fully.
For the frosting, beat butter until smooth. Add powdered sugar in two batches, beating well after each.
Mix in heavy cream, rose water, and cardamom. Beat 2 minutes until fluffy. Add pink food coloring if using.
Pipe frosting high on cooled cupcakes. Top with chopped pistachios and dried rose petals.
tips: Use rose water, not rose extract. Extract is much stronger and can taste like soap if you use too much.
Toast the pistachios lightly in a dry pan for 3 minutes before chopping. This makes the crunch more noticeable.
If your frosting looks too soft, chill it for 10 minutes before piping. Room heat softens butter fast.
Crush a few extra pistachios and press them into the frosting sides for a bakery style finish.

faq.question: Can I use rose syrup instead of rose water in the batter?
faq.answer: Rose syrup has added sugar, so cut the granulated sugar by 2 tablespoons if you swap it in. Use the same 1 tablespoon amount.

faq.question: What if I do not have fresh cardamom pods?
faq.answer: Ground cardamom from a jar works fine here. Just make sure it smells fragrant, since old cardamom loses its punch fast.

faq.question: How do I stop the pistachio crunch from getting soggy?
faq.answer: Add pistachios right before serving, not right after piping. If storing ahead, keep them in a separate container.

faq.question: Can I make these cupcakes ahead for a party?
faq.answer: Bake the cupcakes up to 2 days ahead and store unfrosted at room temperature in a sealed container. Frost the day of serving for the best texture.

conclusion: These cupcakes turn gulab jamun flavors into something you can bring to any bake sale. The rose frosting and pistachio crunch make them feel special without much extra work.
